verdictLegend.PASS: reconstructs modified with a compliant applier

repros.title: Root array cleared to [] emits an unappliable patch
repros.expectation: OLD emits `remove '/'` ops that throw on apply; NEW emits descending index removes that reconstruct [].

old.detail: patch unappliable: Invalid array index "" in path "/"

repros.title: '/' in an object key silently corrupts a sibling on apply
repros.expectation: OLD emits unescaped path `/a/b`, which apply routes into the sibling object `a.b`; NEW escapes to `/a~1b`.

old.detail: applied patch does not reconstruct modified

repros.title: Duplicate primaryKey mutates an UNCHANGED array
repros.expectation: With two items sharing a key and original===modified, OLD emits spurious ops; NEW gates the strategy off and emits nothing.

old.detail: applied patch does not reconstruct modified

repros.title: Keyless item added to a keyed array is silently dropped
repros.expectation: OLD skips the key-less element (empty patch, add lost); NEW falls back to LCS and round-trips.

repros.title: Two different Dates compare equal (silent data loss)
repros.expectation: Both Dates have zero own keys, so OLD's own-key compare treats them equal (empty patch); NEW compares them as opaque leaves.

repros.title: Mutate-in-place then re-diff returns a stale (empty) verdict
repros.expectation: A field mutated in place outside the hash-prefilter set is missed on the second diff by OLD's stale equality cache; NEW's caches are epoch-invalidated.

old.detail: second diff missed the in-place mutation (stale cache)

new.detail: second diff saw the mutation and round-trips

repros.title: basePath prefix-match captures a sibling and corrupts the plan key
repros.expectation: basePath '/env' string-prefix-matches sibling '/envelope/stamps', stripped mid-segment to the unmatchable key 'elope/stamps'; NEW matches on a segment boundary.

old.detail: plan keys never matchable at diff time: ["elope/stamps"]

repros.title: StructuredDiff remove-fallback `\d` regex cooked to literal 'd'
repros.expectation: The index-extraction regex was built in an untagged template where `\d` becomes 'd', so numeric indices never matched. NEW's extractIndexAfterPrefix rejects literal-'d' paths and extracts real indices; v0.4.0 has no such helper to compare against.

old.detail: 0.4.0 aggregator predates the helper; buggy `\d`->'d' path documented in F17

new.detail: regex extracts numeric indices and rejects literal 'd' segments

repros.title: Clearing a huge keyed array RangeErrors via `push(...ops)`
repros.expectation: OLD emits removals with `patches.push(...removalPatches)`; past the runtime arg cap this throws an uncatchable RangeError. NEW emits with a loop. Run in a fresh subprocess.

old.detail: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded.

repros.title: 70k single-edit at the exact 65,536 interning cliff
repros.expectation: NEW's interned-LCS packs window elements to integer ids; the edit at index 65,536 sits on the old 16-bit packing boundary. NEW is proven correct here (regression guard). Published v0.4.0 also passes (its LCS predates the interning rewrite).
